lines: Marie Leroux's voice lines and sound effects. Hover over French text for translations.

- "Bonjour, bonjour! I am Sister Marie Leroux, and Sol be blessed, it is so wonderful to meet you in person. We have been sent here by Cardinal Dimanche - you know him as Entrati - to keep watch over that devil and ensure he does not cause more suffering. Oh! And it seems that what is ancient to you, is not so old to me. How can I help?"
- "Have you come to pray? Or just for "chit-chat?""
- "How may I be of service to you this day? Or is it night? I honestly cannot tell in this place..."
- "I was wondering if you would come by today."
- "If you believe this place to be dreary, you should see from whence we come!"
- "Did no one ever dust in here? Fah! You should see the chandeliers!"
- "Sol has blessed our path to bring us here. Together, we shall see this task complete."

- "Ah, allow me to explain - a Soeur of Sol and your strange weapons, oui? When Monsieur Loid spoke of the Old War and the souvenirs from within, it reminded me of the sagas of the Luminaries - of the monks who would hone their souls to blades. This, I know. And this? I can teach. Come."
- "It is strange to me how much the devil has taken to Bird 3... should we be concerned?"
- "Oh - take your time. I am just enjoying your company."
- "Do you know if the Cavia have any favorite treats? I would like to make them something..."
- "Has anyone polished Monsieur Necraloid lately? It does not seem so."
- "Monsieur Loid may seem hérissé to some, but to me, he seems... sad. Il y a en lui un profonde solitude..."
- "I would ask who that devil believed he was - but he has no problem telling anyone who will listen. At length."
- "I do love all of the jouets and bibelots in this futur étrange!"
- "Look at all you come wearing, so fanciful. Tellement amusant!"
- "The strange woman I have seen - the Lotus? She... unnerves me. And makes my heart ache. I do not understand why."
- "May the light of Sol light your way."
- "Fight to defend those who cannot defend themselves?"
- "Ooh, will you show me what it does some day?"
- "I never thought this knowledge of mine would come to use. If Soeur Céline could only see this. Comme c'est passionnant!"
- "Wield it with conviction, Soldier of Sol!"
Marie: "Your uncertainties have ended. His have not. That is why Lyon must be the one to make this journey. Lyon, return to us with the mighty Hammer of Unairu!"
Lyon: "Come, noble hammer, COGRON, breaker of worlds. The Tenno have returned, and they have need of you once more."
- Marie: "Behold; COGRON the Hammer of Unairu. Once hidden in the Void, now it is yours."
Marie: "Father Lyon knows the shifting horrors of the Void... that path is well-worn for him. Go, Lyon - find in its mists the Staff of Vazarin."
Lyon: "Awaken, ancient-future staff. The time has come for your return to the world of dust. IORO-SHOLOHV: NIDRI!"
- Marie: "NIDRI the Vazarin Staff is now yours, but beware - gifts of the Void must be carefully wielded. Merci, Lyon."
Marie: "One must fly like the arrow to find the Bow of Madurai, or so the Scriptures tell us. Lyon, mon frère, le Néant est dangereux."
Lyon: "THARA! Mighty bow! From the half-real spaces, the twilight backcloth of reality, I call you forth!"
- Marie: "Il revient sain et sauf! And with THARA, the bow of Madurai! Thank you, Sol, for these blessings."

Marie: "In the Void, it seems the knowledge of all possibilities still lives, n'est-ce pas? And those forbidden words are written on the pages of the Grimoire of Zenurik. Father Lyon - the time is nigh."
Lyon: "Righteous Rell guide me. The Tenno you were cast out from now seek your aid. In your name: IORO-SHOLOHV: LORAK!"
- Marie: "He bears LORAK, the grimoire of Zenurik! I pray it did not whisper to you, Father Lyon. Such secrets are périlleux."
Marie: "As we would cleave the Void, so you would do with your enemies, n'est-ce pas? Lyon, they seek the Sword of Naramon."
Lyon: "The sword that was consigned to the Void and forgotten. IORO-SHOLOHV: VEXORIC! For Lua. And for what remains of humanity!"
- Marie: "VEXORIC, the Naramon Blade! Returned to us like a ballad of olden times, come to life! Rest now, Lyon, dearest brother."
- "Oh! Par la grâce de Sol! Are you certain?"
- "Oui! Oh, my wolf, I thought you would never ask..."
- "Have you made up your mind, this time? I do not wish to be petulant, but I am not going to forgive you a third time."
- "I... very well? You must take the time to make up your mind. I will be here when you do."
- "Forgive me, Drifter - but I have to say... non. Now, go. I have prayers to attend."
- "This little folie of yours ends now, Drifter."
- "Gauche, droite - haut, bas! Pick one, please!"
- "Have you come to pray? Or... something else, perhaps...?"
- "I have missed you so, beloved wolf."
- "Ask it, and it is yours. Always."
- "Come to steal a kiss, have you? You would make a sinner of me yet."
- "Careful, lest we make the devil jealous."
- "Farewell, my wolf... do not stray for long."
- "I shall wait for you here with a smile upon my face."
- "You will... return to your little Marie soon, n'est-ce pas?"
- [giggles] "Go, before the others tease us, my wolf!"
- "You have brought Lyon such peace... I thank you from the bottom of my heart."
- "I see Lyon smiling in the quiet moments, when he thinks I do not notice. And it is because of you."
- "I do not know if you have brought him any answers. But I know you have brought him company. And that... that is enough."

- "Lyon has always been a brother to me, where all other family has fled. He has known nothing but uncertainty, where he is... the only tangible certainty I have ever known. Be kind to him. ...Please."
- "I could not have imagined this place, this futur étrange, could have become a home for us. Merci. Merci."
- "You have learned to navigate with Lyon the delicate line between agonie and joie. Lua bless you. "
- "One will never truly know the burden of another, but you know what it means to offer help."
- "Lyon will always feel agonie, there will always be visions. Some sickness cannot be cured, some pain never fades. But for us? We have la famille."
- "I often wondered what kind of pain has made our devil what he has become... and now we know a little of it, thanks to you."
- "Even the mood between Lyon and our devil is much improved. Our devil no longer feels the need to cheat so much at cards."
- "I did not think it could be done, but... our devil is slightly more sufferable. While I question your taste - I cannot question the result."
- "While I never truly expected our devil to change, I can admit I do not think I would want him to, anymore. Thank you."
- "I suppose you have proven even our devil himself deserves love, n'est-ce pas?"
- "Is it the tail? ... It is the tail. I knew it was the tail."
- "I promise not to hound our Devil as much. If he has you around to keep him on good behavior, of course."
> Thank you for this wonderful time we shared, my wolf. I shall remember it fondly. I hope you will, as well.
- Marie: "This is the place you made for yourself? A whole world. My wolf, oh my wolf... what a marvel you are..."

- Marie: "I know this place... became a Hell for you, mon coeur. And for that, my heart weeps. But I see in it such beauty. I see these people you have fashioned and I... I only wish to comfort them in my arms. "
- Marie: "Someday, I would like to meet this Dominus Thrax. D'un garnement à l'autre. I think your little Marie could talk some sense into him."

- Marie: "Oh, my wolf... I hope you have not given up hope for this... this monde merveilleux. It is a part of you, and I find that I cannot help but fall in love with it so completely. I do not wish to say goodbye to it."

- Marie: "Can we stay here but just a little longer? It is as though I am wrapped up in your very soul, and I... I find I do not wish to leave, mon coeur. Besides - This one over here has not finished telling their story."
- Marie: "I do not know if the others will ever come to forgive le Cardinal for what he must do in his crusade against the Indifference... but I can only hope that Sol hears my prayers, mon coeur. "

- Marie: "In all these books, these scrolls - I read the words of a man torn in half by duty and love. I do not see a man made of callous hatred and malcontent. I hope some day the others can come to see this too, my wolf..."
- Marie: "What a beautiful place this is. A place of study, of learning, of repose and above all, purpose. Le Cardinal leads a crusade. And we, my wolf, are but his soldiers. "

- Marie: "Who are we to question a genius such as le Cardinal? Look at all he has built - all he has made. I see the Sanctum... the Vessels. When he calls, we must follow, mon coeur. Wherever he may go."

- Marie: "It breaks my heart to think that le Cardinal cannot forgive himself for what harm he has left in his wake. He is trying to save all of creation against a god most terrible. Against Indifference itself. Of course he can be forgiven... certainly no price is too steep, n'est-ce pas?"

- Marie: "Oh, mon coeur... What a fool I was, to think le Cardinal above all reproach. I cannot dismiss all the good he did - all the kindness he showed me and others. But neither can I dismiss the cruelty and harm he showed others..."

- Marie: "I can only pray to Sol that someday... somehow... we might find Entrati. That I might speak to him and tell him that I can forgive him. Though I do not know if he can ever forgive himself..."

- Marie: "Thank you, mon coeur, for being patient with me. Your little Marie was being stubborn, I admit. I wished to hold on to what little hope I could that le Cardinal was a bastion of good in this world. Aah, I should have known, nothing is ever so simple."

- Marie: "I do hope that Entrati can find reason enough to return to us - if only for the sake of his daughter and Monsieur Loid. They miss him so terribly... and it pains me to see love so ripped in half, mon coeur."

- Marie: "What a day it will be, if le Cardinal returns to us in the Sanctum, my wolf. I look forward to it, yet... I do worry that M'sieur Tagfer may bite Entrati in le derrière if we do not watch him."
- Marie: "Oh, my heart soars to see this! How it reminds me of home - of the marketplaces of la Cité de la Lumière. So much has changed, yet the laughter - the laughter is the same."
- Marie: "I hear a name they praise - the Unum - is this their god? Quelle magnificence! I thank the Unum for this beautiful place. For these wonderful people."
- Marie: "How I could sit and spend all day learning their ways and culture, mon coeur, but then you would have none of me for yourself, I think!"
- Marie: "There is so much life in this future, my wolf! So much happiness yet to be shared! Thank you for bringing me to this place. Merci, merci, merci!"

- Marie: "Tonight, I will light the candles and thank Sol for the people of Cetus, and I think I will thank the Unum as well. We are so small, in the end. Who am I to say they are not siblings, or that they are not one and the same?"
- Marie: "Now these garnements, I would know anywhere, by any faces or names! Your little Marie grew up on the streets, do not forget. And it seems, so much has not changed with time."

- Marie: "Their language is so strange to me, but then again - mine would be so strange to them, non? There is one language that speaks above all others, I think. Hardship. And that we both knew so very well in our young years, mon coeur."

- Marie: "I would ask to try their floating boards but - I hardly have the need, do I? I would have adored one back before my inconveniences were solved, non? To think... I could have had des pieds métalliques instead."

- Marie: "How different my life would have been, if I grew up here on this far-flung world and not on the streets of la Cité de la Lumière. Yet I see their faces, and I... see the faces of Hugo. Of Vitor. Eugénie. Madeline. Oh, my wolf... it is always the smallest who suffer most."
- Marie: "This artwork... do you think they will sell us some? I would like to hang it on the wall by our devil. I think it will annoy him greatly. Yes, I think it will annoy him very much indeed."
- Marie: "Ooh, somewhere we might truly be alone... naughty wolf. Sshh! Do you feel something? I do not know as we are not as alone as we may think."
- Marie: "Your Ordis! He is tres mignon! I do not think he has met a protoframe before, non? The questions he asked me - very inappropriate. And very humorous. I think I adore him, mon coeur."

- Marie: "Oh, mon coeur. What a beautiful place this is, with such a wonderful view of the sky. A long way away from the cryptes, n'est-ce pas? But I would come to miss my Lyon, and... even our devil, though do not tell him I said that."
- Marie: "The Zariman... Duviri... This place... your home in the past... Now I know why they call you 'the Drifter,' my wolf. I wonder, where will you make your home next, hm?"

- Marie: "I could grow quite the garden here, I think. Would you mind? Some roses - some lilacs - some nightshade. Hm. Do those exist in this time, anymore? I suppose not! You must have new flowers to grow!"
For full quotes, see The Descendia/Quotes.

- Marie: "I was just about to light the candles."
- Marie: "Bonjour, bonjour! Peace... what little I can grant, in this dreary place."
- Marie: "Come, rest - and take what blessings Sol may grant to you."
- Marie: "Here, I might gather you into my mind, if only for a little."
- Marie: "A moment to breathe, before we move on, n'est-ce pas?"
- Marie: "In this desolation of the devil's mind, we take what shelter we can."
- Marie: "Come! Sol's light has not abandoned you yet - and neither have I."
- Marie: "And did you think little Marie had left your side? Jamais!"
- Marie: "Mon coeur, there you are! I was so worried!"
- Marie: "And there is my wolf, at last - come, let me tend to you."
- Marie: "Oh, mon coeur! Come, and let me give you my help in this terrible place."
- Marie: "I do not know why you insist on helping that awful devil - but where my wolf goes, I shall always follow."
- Marie: "I shall never leave your side, mon coeur."
- Marie: "Take shelter in me, mon coeur - as I so often have in you."
- Marie: "My wolf - rest, and let me comfort thee in what little ways I can."
- Marie: "Come, mon coeur! Let Sol bless you, as you have blessed me."
- Marie: "If we are going to stand about and collect dust, I would rather do it somewhere else, n'est-ce pas?"
- Marie: "I do not like lingering in the devil's mind. It makes me... itch."
- Marie: "The longer we stay here, the more I start to feel like I have a tail. Can we go now, s'il vous plaît?"
- Marie: "Is there a purpose to your stalling, or have you fallen asleep?"
- Marie: "I do not think we can stand here forever. Ô Sol, tout sauf ça. Je ne veux pas être piégée dans l'esprit de ce singe pour tout l'éternité..."
- Marie: "Are we... lingering... for a reason? There must be a reason... n'est-ce pas?"
- Marie: "Are you looking for hidden prizes? Trésors de lutin, perhaps?"
- Marie: "I do not like the fighting, but... neither do I trust the silence. May we go?"
- Marie: "Sol has guided us here for a reason... there is much work to be done."
- Marie: "May the light of Sol show the way through this dark and accursed place. Stay strong. We are with you."
- Marie: "I beseech thee, Sol, to bless them. For though you do not know their face, you know their heart."
- Marie: "Sol will guide you now through this terrible task, I know it. Be strong."
- Marie: "With Sol's light, we will endure."
- Marie: "Be strong, mon coeur - I am with you."
- Marie: "I have faith in you, my wolf."
- Marie: "These corrupted memories will never defeat you, mon coeur!"
- Marie: "Remember, mon coeur - the devil's horrid past cannot harm you, if you do not let it."
- "Let us write gospels of fire and steel."
- "The world is heavy with great wickedness."
- "We shall carry the torch of truth in godless lands."
- "Fear nothing while Marie is with you."
- "We will be tested. Pain and bitter ashes await."
- "Come. Let us bring about a radiant new day!"
- "What do I care for my scars, when I can dance upon the air?"
- "If Sol is with us, who can stand against us?"
- "The strange angel is calling? Me voici!"
- "I am Sister Marie Leroux, ordained of Sol, sworn to Lua, and bearer of the holy fire!"
- "Again I am cast from my own time into this mad reverie!"
- "From convent walls and gentle prayers... to this."
- "Let the blade be my hymnbook now."
- "I may kneel to pray, but never in surrender!"
- "May the Gods forgive me for what I must do."
- "Fear? I, who have held the hand of the Devil as he wept?"
- "Mon ange... you must forgive me if I tremble."
- "Your light is soft as stars, sweet as a million kisses."
- "You come to me as a smiling devil answers a lonely prayer."
- "Mmm. This lamb has missed her hungry wolf."
- "I would gladly walk through the fire to be with you, mon ange!"
- "Fill my heart as Sol's light fills the world."
- "Am I to be pierced once more by the thorns of your love?"
- "You enfold my heart, and once more I walk upon the air."
- "Lua would blush if my thoughts of you could be seen!"
- "War shall be my bridesmaid, and Death shall bear my wedding train!"
- "Do you feel this racing heart? This rising heat, this quickening?"
- "Leave shame to the devil, for love like ours is no sin."
- "Enfold me. Enflame me. Make me whole."
- "Are you howling for your Marie again, beloved wolf?"
- "To be apart from you is the only hell I fear."
- "Ah, what has become of this shy little novice?"
- "If I ever shrank from your embrace, I repent my folly now!"
- "My love. Let us burn together and rise as incense to the Gods."
- "Do not abandon me for long, strange angel."
- "Bon! I shall dance with the shadows."
- "Go. I have the Luminaries to watch over me."
- "Return soon, and lend me your light once more!"
- "Again you depart? I am a temple, not une auberge!"
- "Very well. I shall pray in silence... and stillness."
- "Bold you are, to go without the armor of Marie."
- "Take care. The ways are dark and devil-haunted."
- "As the candle to the flame, we are united."
- "I shall be your robe of benediction."
- "Douce Lua! A little warning next time, s'il te plait?"
- "I pray this strange possession is no sin."
- "I shall be the chalice, you the wine."
- "May I trust you not to pry into my secret thoughts?"
- "Fear nothing while Marie is your armor."
- "Prends garde. I am no filly to be trotted through the briars!"
- "Let us walk the path of virtue together."
- "You return to the fold, and I rejoice."
- "Be changeable as Lua, and I shall remain constant as Sol."
- "What wild visions did those eyes see?"
- "If you must bloody these hands, do it with compassion."
- "The Gods have forged me to be a weapon in your grasp."
- "Be my guide in these desolate places."
- "You will not make us martyrs today!"
- "Their weapons shall not prosper against us!"
- "You seek a reckoning? So be it!"
- "We shall water our gardens with the blood of the unrighteous."
- "Ah! You have made a killer out of little Marie."
- "May the burden of sin trouble you no more."
- "This little wren has the claws of the hawk!"
- "Lua may weep for you, dead one, but not I."
- "Ah, mère supérieure, you trained me for sweeter things!"
- "The beauty of death never scared me."
- "'Those who bear steel in my name shall be crowned with holy gold.'"
- "Now the veil of life is lifted!"
- "'A kiss of peace on the eyes of the dying.'"
- "I shall dig no grave; I shall plant no stone."
- "'Rest in sunset's blood to be reborn with the dawn.'"
- "A lily on my grave, s'il vous plaît."
- "I am not worthy of this life..."
- "I know I have killed. This end is just."
- "A sacred sign, to show the way."
- "The light of Lua upon this spot."
- "The hand of Sol points the way!"
- "Perhaps here is something to be found?"
- "The Gods call us to this place!"
- "Like a little mouse in the rafters, I see much."
- "See with the eyes of the soul."
- "I lay my mark upon this place."
- "By Sol and by Lua I condemn you!"
- "They are foul in the eyes of the Gods!"
- "Grant them the blessing of sweet death!"
- "Cut them down, and let me bear the blame!"
- "This is not like the time Lyon took me sledding..."
- "You will not let me fall off, hm?"
